battle.name: 安哥拉內戰
battle.theater: 安哥拉中部高原與南部邊境戰線
battle.brief: 一九七五年五月，解放運動與全國解放陣線為爭羅安達而交火，葡軍十一月撤走，古巴、南非、美國先後介入，直至二〇〇二年《洛納備忘錄》才停火。卡面這具一八五〇年德國線膛野戰砲並未到過安哥拉，但它確立的砲兵射程壓過步兵的傳統，延續成一九八七年奎托卡萬阿萊一二二與一五二公厘野戰砲的對射。

kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 安哥拉內戰自一九七五年五月起，到二〇〇二年八月《洛納備忘錄》簽署為止，交戰主體是三支由殖民時期反葡萄牙武裝演變出來的政治軍事組織，以及四支外來干預力量。安哥拉人民解放運動掌握解放軍與主要城市，一九七五年由阿戈什蒂諾·內圖任主席，一九七九年九月內圖病逝後由若澤·埃杜阿多·多斯桑托斯接任，軍隊是安哥拉人民武裝部隊，下轄師、旅級作戰單位，並自一九七六年起設有本國的砲兵部隊與後勤指揮體系。全國解放陣線由霍爾登·羅伯托與伊西亞斯·阿戈蘭人創建，倚仗薩伊蒙博托政府的補給與一九七五年葡萄牙的暗中支持，一九七六年初在薩伊另立臨時政府；同年三月奎托卡萬阿萊戰役之後，其作為野戰軍被摧毀。全國解放聯盟自陣營中分出，一九七六年正式成立，由若內斯·薩文比任最高指揮官，其後基地設在納穆比亞境內，靠美國與南非輸血。外來方面：一九七五年十一月五日古巴革命武裝部隊以「卡洛塔行動」自剛果邊境進入安哥拉，組建三八六獨立坦克旅；南非國防軍自一九七五年起以「薩瓦納行動」出兵，一九八一年十二月再以「明星行動」打到奎托卡萬阿萊；納米比亞人民解放組織的武裝在南部配合古巴軍與解放軍作戰；葡萄牙則在《阿爾沃爾協議》名下撤退，一九七五年十一月二十五日完成最後撤出。
countriesEn: The Angolan Civil War ran from May 1975 to the signing of the Luena Memorandum in August 2002. The belligerents were three political-military organisations that had grown out of the anti-Portuguese insurgent movement of the colonial era, together with four external intervention forces. The People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola held the army and the principal cities; Agostinho Neto chaired it from 1975, and after his death in September 1979 José Eduardo dos Santos succeeded him. Its armed force was the People's Armed Forces of Angola, organised into divisional and brigaded tactical units, with its own artillery and logistics command structure established from 1976 onward. The National Front for the Liberation of Angola, founded by Holden Roberto and Izias Angolanismo, drew supply from the Mobutu government in Zaire and covert Portuguese backing, and in early 1976 set up a rival provisional government across the border in Zaire; after the Battle of Kuito Cuanavale in March 1976 it ceased to exist as a field army. The National Union for the Total Independence of Angola split away from the FNLA camp and was formally founded in 1976 under Jonas Savimbi as supreme commander, with its bases thereafter in Namibian territory, supplied by the United States and South Africa. On the external side, the Cuban Revolutionary Armed Forces entered Angola from the Congolese border on 5 November 1975 in Operation Carlota and formed the 386th Independent Tank Brigade; the South African Defence Force intervened from 1975 under Operation Savannah and struck at Cuito Cuanavale again in December 1981 under Operation Protea; the armed wing of SWAPO fought alongside the Cuban and Angolan forces in the south; and Portugal withdrew under the Alvor Agreement, completing its final departure on 25 November 1975.
people: 安哥拉內戰的關鍵人物幾乎全在三方最高統帥與兩位外來決策者手上。一九七五年至一九七九年的安哥拉人民解放運動主席阿戈什蒂諾·內圖把黨、軍、國合併，以「一條火力線」的游擊理論指導初期作戰，並在一九七六年拒絕在《阿爾沃爾協議》的權力分享安排上讓步；一九七九年九月他病逝後，副手若澤·埃杜阿多·多斯桑托斯接掌黨軍國家，主持了經濟調整方向的改革、化解一九九二年選舉後的緊張局面，以及二〇〇二年《洛納備忘錄》的談判。全國解放聯盟的若內斯·薩文比自一九七六年起是游擊隊唯一有效的指揮核心，他堅持以農民與高地部族為基層，靠南非的情報、砲兵與空軍支援維持作戰，一九九〇年納穆比亞獨立使他的後方基地喪失，一九九八年美國國會中止援助後他仍拒絕解除武裝，一九九九年三月二日在莫西科省莫倫克萊的陣地遭迫擊砲擊斃，軍勢隨之崩解。全國解放陣線的霍爾登·羅伯托在蒙博托庇護下於薩伊另立政府，使安哥拉的合法性問題長期與薩伊的方針綁在一起。外部方面，古巴的菲德爾·卡斯特羅政府決定在十一月冒險介入並長期屯兵；南非總統P.W.博塔與國防部長麥格努斯·馬蘭把安哥拉視為「邊界戰爭」的一部分，決定在一九八一年底用重裝機械化深入；美國總統雷根則透過中央情報局與南非的管道持續支援全國解放聯盟，國會在一九九八年立法中止這條援助；一九九〇年代後期，聯合國與葡萄牙的斡旋、以及安哥拉解放軍內主張轉向進攻的一批將領（其後出任總統的若昂·洛倫索在參謀長任內推動的攻勢）把殘局推向結束。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities of the Angolan Civil War sat in the three supreme commanders and two outside decision-makers. Agostinho Neto, chairman of the MPLA from 1975 to 1979, fused party, army and state, steered the opening phase with a guerrilla doctrine of the 'line of fire', and in 1976 refused to concede ground in the power-sharing arrangements of the Alvor Agreement; after his death in September 1979 his deputy José Eduardo dos Santos took over party, army and state, steered the market-oriented economic adjustment, defused the crisis that followed the 1992 election, and led the negotiations that produced the Luena Memorandum of 2002. Jonas Savimbi was from 1976 the only effective command core of the guerrilla, insisting on a base of peasants and the highland communities and keeping his force supplied by South African intelligence, artillery and air power; Namibia's independence in 1990 robbed him of his rear bases, and after the United States Congress cut off aid in 1998 he still refused to disarm. He was killed by mortar fire at Moruncle in Moxico province on 2 March 1999, and the movement collapsed with him. Holden Roberto of the FNLA set up a rival government in Zaire under Mobutu's patronage, tying the question of Angolan legitimacy to Zaire's policy for years. Outside the country, Fidel Castro's Cuban government decided to take the risk of intervention in November and to keep troops in the country for the long term; South African President P. W. Botha and Defence Minister Magnus Malan treated Angola as part of the border war and chose a heavily mechanised penetration at the end of 1981; President Reagan sustained support for UNITA through the Central Intelligence Agency and the South African channel, and Congress ended that support by legislation in 1998. In the late 1990s, mediation by the United Nations and Portugal, together with the offensive pushed by the Angolan commanders who favoured going on the attack — among them João Lourenço, who drove it while chief of the general staff and later became president — brought the endgame to a close.
kits: 卡面那具一八五〇年的德國線膛野戰砲採用針狀雷管點火，是世上第一批線膛野戰砲之一：同樣的藥量因為膛線旋轉而能走得更遠，砲兵第一次可以在射程上壓過步兵。這條技術線在安哥拉內戰裡以另一種形式走到盡頭——一八五〇年代的野戰砲讓位給一八七〇年代的後膛砲與榴彈炮，最後在一九四〇年代被反戰車炮與自走砲瓜分戰場。真正出現在安哥拉的武器屬於另一套體系：解放軍與古巴軍以AK-47步槍、七六二公厘自動步槍為骨幹，配置一二二、一三〇與一五二公厘野戰榴彈炮、多管火箭炮與反戰車火箭筒；古巴方面另有三八六獨立坦克旅的T-34/85與T-54/55坦克；南非國防軍在一九八〇年代裝備G5一三〇公厘自走砲與G6一五五公厘自走榴彈炮、T-5一五五公厘拖曳炮與「瓦哈拉」式火箭炮，配合立德曼式裝甲車與裝甲兵組成的機動打擊群，以及一個中隊規模的航空兵；全國解放聯盟的步兵用FN FAL與南非仿製的R1步槍及蘇制AK式步槍，火力核心是BM-21多管火箭炮與一二二公厘榴彈炮，後期還得到蘇聯與中國的步槍與榴彈炮補充；全國解放陣線在七十年代經薩伊運入比利時與法國步槍及少量重型武器。交通方面，比格拉鐵路的卡通古走廊與羅安達、洛比托、本格拉三個港口是外來軍火與燃料的命脈，公路車隊、騾馬馱運與蘇聯的安-12、安-24與C-130運輸機共同構成補給線，末期還有民間商車偽裝通行輸送物資。
kitsEn: The German rifled muzzle-loading field gun of 1850 shown on the card, fired by a needle percussion mechanism, was among the first rifled field guns in the world: the same charge now carried further because the rifling spun the shot, and artillery could for the first time outrange infantry. That thread reached the end of its line in the Angolan Civil War, though in another form — the field gun of the 1850s gave way to the breech-loading gun and the howitzer of the 1870s, and in the 1940s its place on the battlefield was shared out between the anti-tank gun and the self-propelled howitzer. The weapons actually present in Angola belonged to a different family. The People's Armed Forces of Angola and the Cuban forces used AK-47 rifles and 7.62mm automatic rifles as their backbone, backed by 122mm, 130mm and 152mm field howitzers, multiple rocket launchers and anti-tank rocket launchers; Cuba also brought the T-34/85 and T-54/55 tanks of the 386th Independent Tank Brigade. The South African Defence Force in the 1980s was equipped with the G5 130mm and G6 155mm self-propelled howitzers, the towed T-5 155mm gun and the Valhalla rocket artillery, supported by Liedeman-type armoured cars and the mechanised strike groups built around them, together with an air force squadron. UNITA's infantry fought with FN FAL rifles, the South African-made R1 and AK-pattern weapons, and its firepower core was the BM-21 multiple rocket launcher and the 122mm howitzer, later supplemented with rifles and howitzers from the Soviet Union and China; the FNLA in the 1970s received Belgian and French rifles and a small amount of heavy equipment through Zaire. In terms of movement, the Catumbela corridor of the Benguela railway and the ports of Luanda, Lobito and Benguela were the lifelines for foreign arms and fuel, and the supply line was carried by road convoys, mule trains and the Soviet An-12, An-24 and C-130 transports, with civilian lorries in the closing years passing the line disguised as couriers.
tactics: 安哥拉內戰的戰術可以分成三段。一九七五年五月的羅安達之戰是市區槍戰與街壘爭奪，解放軍以游擊隊的散兵與迫擊砲小組壓制全國解放陣線在機場與港口一線的據點；同年十一月二十五日葡軍完成撤退後，解放軍的游擊隊仍沿用殖民時期的「一條火力線」打法，在本土縱深殲滅敵方游擊隊。一九七五年十一月的「卡洛塔行動」是裝甲縱隊的長距離突進：古巴先頭部隊在剛果邊際的科布拉角登陸，以坦克、裝甲車與隨軍步兵沿公路急行軍，兩週內佔領奎托卡萬阿萊，切斷全國解放陣線自薩伊運來的物資。一九七六年三月奎托卡萬阿萊之役是全戰役最典型的砲兵戰：解放軍集中一〇五、一二二與一五二公厘野戰砲，古巴提供砲兵顧問與空中支援，把戰線壓成一道火牆，全國解放陣線在縱深砲火下崩潰。一九八〇年代作戰雙方都現代化：南非以縱隊形態進入，每個縱隊配工程、醫療與補給分隊，沿T4公路與卡盧埃克的燃料庫補給；解放軍改採縱深梯隊配置，在卡廷加高原建立梯隊與預備隊；全國解放聯盟在南部高地以游擊隊伏擊公路車隊，並以BM-21多管火箭炮齊射之後才投入突擊。一九八七年十一月至一九八八年三月奎托卡萬阿萊之役是決戰：古巴與解放軍守軍依據村落、樹線與反斜面構築散兵坑與機槍巢，解放軍的「青年運動」把一批縱隊調往前線，南非以T-6與G6自走砲及空軍支援全國解放聯盟攻擊，攻城與反攻城同時進行，最終以南非方面的撤退收場。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the Angolan Civil War fall into three phases. The fighting in Luanda in May 1975 was a street war fought over barricades, with the MPLA pressing the FNLA positions around the airfield and the harbour with small infantry groups and mortar teams. After the Portuguese completed their withdrawal on 25 November 1975, the MPLA guerrillas still fought with the colonial-era 'line of fire' method, breaking the enemy guerrillas in the interior. Operation Carlota of November 1975 was a long armoured thrust: the Cuban vanguard landed at Pointe du Cobra on the Zaire border and drove hard along the road with tanks, armoured cars and dismounted infantry, taking Cuito Cuanavale within a fortnight and cutting off the FNLA's supplies coming out of Zaire. The Battle of Kuito Cuanavale in March 1976 was the archetypal artillery battle of the whole war: the FAPLA massed 105mm, 122mm and 152mm field howitzers, Cuba supplied artillery advisers and air support, and the line was pressed into a wall of fire that broke the FNLA in depth. The 1980s saw both sides modernise: the South Africans entered in column, each column with engineer, medical and supply detachments, advancing along the T4 road and the fuel depots at Calueque; the FAPLA switched to a system of echelons in depth, building echelons and reserves on the Catinga plateau; and UNITA in the southern highlands ambushed road convoys and massed BM-21 rocket salvos before committing an assault. The decisive round, from November 1987 to March 1988, was fought at Cuito Cuanavale: the Cuban and Angolan defenders built foxholes and machine-gun nests from the villages, tree lines and reverse slopes, the 'young Turks' of the MPLA moved fresh echelons to the front, and South Africa supported the UNITA assault with T-6 and G6 self-propelled howitzers and air power, the siege and the countersiege running together until the South African side withdrew.
data: 時間跨度：一九七五年五月至二〇〇二年八月，前後約二十七年，中間只有數次短暫停火。葡萄牙撤軍：最後一批葡軍於一九七五年十一月二十五日離境。古巴介入：首次「卡洛塔行動」一九七五年十一月五日開始，先頭部隊一至二千人；至一九七六年古巴在安哥拉的兵力增至二萬上下；一九八〇年代後期作戰部隊約三萬，連同家屬與技術人員逾五萬，三八六獨立坦克旅配備數百輛坦克與裝甲車。全國解放陣線在一九七五年兵力膨脹至數萬人，一九七六年三月奎托卡萬阿萊之役後作戰能力基本瓦解。全國解放聯盟在八十年代後期估計有三萬至五萬戰鬥員，一九九九年後急速萎縮至數千人。解放軍由一九七五年數萬名裝備落後的游擊隊員膨脹到八十年代後期為數十萬的常備軍。決戰數字：一九八七年十一月至一九八八年三月的奎托卡萬阿萊之役，防守方約一萬五千至二萬人（古巴、解放軍與納米比亞武裝），進攻方南非軍約六千至一萬二千人、全國解放聯盟一至三千人；南非與聯盟方面陣亡在數百人量級，古巴方面官方在哈瓦那為一九七五至一九九一年陣亡者立碑，刻名以兩千人上下計。戰爭全程消耗的火箭炮與野戰砲以數千門計。一九九二年九月二十九日大選，解放運動的總統選票得票接近五成但未過半，第二輪於一九九三年八月舉行，計票爭議使戰事重開。二〇〇二年八月三十一日《洛納備忘錄》簽署，解除武裝與復員接納了數千名前武裝人員。
dataEn: Duration: from May 1975 to August 2002, about twenty-seven years, interrupted only by a few short ceasefires. Portuguese withdrawal: the last Portuguese troops left on 25 November 1975. Cuban intervention: the first Operation Carlota began on 5 November 1975 with a vanguard of one to two thousand men; by 1976 the Cuban force in Angola had grown to around twenty thousand; in the late 1980s there were roughly thirty thousand combat troops, more than fifty thousand including families and technicians, and the 386th Independent Tank Brigade fielded several hundred tanks and armoured vehicles. The FNLA's strength swelled to tens of thousands in 1975, and after the Battle of Kuito Cuanavale in March 1976 its fighting power was essentially destroyed. UNITA is estimated to have had thirty to fifty thousand fighters in the late 1980s, contracting to a few thousand after 1999. The FAPLA grew from tens of thousands of poorly equipped guerrillas in 1975 to a regular army of several hundred thousand by the late 1980s. The decisive figures: in the Battle of Cuito Cuanavale from November 1987 to March 1988 the defenders numbered about fifteen to twenty thousand (Cuban, Angolan and Namibian forces) against six to twelve thousand South Africans and one to three thousand UNITA men; South African and UNITA losses ran to the hundreds, while Cuba's official memorial in Havana for those who fell between 1975 and 1991 carries about two thousand names. Across the war, thousands of rocket launchers and field guns were expended. In the election of 29 September 1992 the MPLA won just under half of the presidential vote, and the second round held in August 1993 was followed by a dispute over the count that put the war back on. The Luena Memorandum was signed on 31 August 2002, and the disarmament and reintegration that followed absorbed several thousand former fighters.
cause: 安哥拉內戰的起因是殖民戰爭的突然終止。葡萄牙在非洲最大的一場殖民戰爭打了十四年，一九七四年四月二十五日「康乃馨革命」推翻里斯本的獨裁政府，首都數日之內換了領導層，海外殖民地的去留被擱在一邊；一九七五年一月十五日葡政府與安哥拉人民解放運動、全國解放陣線等簽訂《阿爾沃爾協議》，試圖以三派共治的過渡安排取代戰爭，卻在幾個月內被彼此的猜忌與各自的建軍需要撕開，同年五月解放軍與全國解放陣線在羅安達交火，葡軍到十月面對的是一場已經開打、而它無法再壓制的三方混戰，十一月二十五日完成撤退後，國家主權交到了三支武裝手上。深層原因是殖民時期留下的社會結構與資源分配：安哥拉有石油與鑽石，卻沒有本土的財政與行政骨幹，誰控制中部高原的鄉村，誰就控制徵糧與徵兵；三支力量各有自己的部族與地域基礎，人民解放運動靠的是包含各部族的城市群眾組織與馬列主義黨國體制，全國解放陣線倚仗北部與薩伊的關係，全國解放聯盟則以奧溫布人為核心的高地社會為根基，卻在冷戰格局裡站到了西方與南非一邊。外部因素把本地衝突變成代理人戰爭：古巴以革命國際主義出兵，美國以中央情報局經南非與薩伊輸送武器，蘇聯提供武器與顧問，納米比亞人民解放組織的戰爭把南部戰區與安哥拉綁在一起。
causeEn: The Angolan Civil War began because a colonial war ended abruptly. Portugal had fought its largest war in Africa for fourteen years; the Carnation Revolution of 25 April 1974 overthrew the dictatorship in Lisbon, the leadership of the capital changed within days, and the fate of the overseas colonies was left hanging. On 15 January 1975 the Portuguese government signed the Alvor Agreement with the MPLA and the FNLA among others, trying to replace the war with a transition in which three parties would share power; within months the agreement was torn apart by mutual suspicion and by each side's need to build an army, the MPLA and the FNLA fought in Luanda in May, and by October the Portuguese faced a three-way war already under way that they could no longer suppress, so that after completing the withdrawal on 25 November they handed sovereignty over to three armed groups. The deeper causes lay in the social structure and the distribution of resources left behind by colonialism: Angola had oil and diamonds but no domestic fiscal or administrative backbone, and whoever controlled the villages of the central plateau controlled the food and the recruits. Each of the three forces had its own ethnic and regional base — the MPLA on the urban mass organisation that embraced all communities and on a Marxist-Leninist party-state, the FNLA on its ties to the north and to Zaire, UNITA on the highland society of the Ovimbundu, which in the Cold War alignment put it on the Western and South African side. External factors turned a local conflict into a proxy war: Cuba intervened in the name of revolutionary internationalism, the United States supplied arms through the Central Intelligence Agency via South Africa and Zaire, the Soviet Union provided weapons and advisers, and the Namibian war bound the southern theatre to Angola.
impact: 安哥拉內戰是冷戰在非洲最大的一場代理人戰爭，二十七年裡把三種軍事制度在同一片土地上試了一遍：一九七〇年代是游擊隊對殖民警衛隊與正規步兵的叢林戰，一九八〇年代是裝甲縱隊對砲兵支撐的縱深機動作戰，一九九〇年代則是精確導引武器與武裝直升機對上仍在用BM-21與一五五公厘砲的傳統砲兵。戰爭把古巴的軍事學派推成全球性示範：三八六獨立坦克旅與古巴營級教練體系被複製到埃塞俄比亞、尼加拉瓜、越南與格林納達等戰場，古巴自己也因長期海外屯兵與「大特殊時期」的資源耗盡而改變國策。對安哥拉而言，戰爭帶來三重結構性後果：其一，軍隊國家化，解放軍由游擊隊變成全國最大的武裝集團，掌握礦區、港口與國防承包體系；其二，政權性格轉變，一九九〇年代實行的市場化改革與其後的石油收益，讓黨與軍隊的關係從「民族解放」轉為「國家控股」；其三，老式野戰砲的技術終點也在這裡——BM-21與一五五公厘自走砲在八十年代末仍是有效火力，到九十年代被精確導引炸藥與定點攻擊取代，線膛時代的野戰砲在安哥拉退場。安哥拉在一九九〇年正式與美國斷交，國際孤立，石油出口通道被切斷，直到一九九三年才重新獲得信貸與援助渠道；戰後安哥拉的原油產量在二〇〇〇年代中期升到每日數十萬桶，成為撒哈拉以南非洲僅次於尼日利亞與阿爾及利亞的產油國之一。
impactEn: The Angolan Civil War was the largest proxy war of the Cold War in Africa, and over twenty-seven years it tried out three different military systems on the same ground: in the 1970s a guerrilla war against the colonial police and regular infantry, in the 1980s armoured columns against an artillery-supported war of manoeuvre in depth, and in the 1990s precision-guided weapons and armed helicopters against an artillery still firing BM-21 rocket salvos and 155mm guns. The war turned Cuban military doctrine into a global demonstration: the 386th Independent Tank Brigade and the Cuban battalion-level coaching system were copied to theatres in Ethiopia, Nicaragua, Vietnam and Grenada, and Cuba itself changed policy after years of overseas garrison and the exhaustion of the Special Period. For Angola the war left three structural consequences. First, militarisation of the state: the liberation movement's armed forces became the largest armed group in the country, with control of the mining areas, the ports and the defence contracting system. Second, a change in the character of the regime: the market reforms of the 1990s and the oil revenue that followed turned the relationship between party and army from national liberation into state control. Third, the technical end of the old gun came here too: the BM-21 and the 155mm self-propelled howitzer were still effective in the late 1980s, but in the 1990s they were displaced by precision-guided munitions and attacks on fixed targets, and the field gun of the rifled era left the Angolan battlefield. Angola broke relations with the United States in 1990 and was diplomatically isolated with its oil export routes cut, regaining credit and aid channels only in 1993; after the war its crude output rose to several hundred thousand barrels a day in the mid-2000s, making it one of the largest oil producers in sub-Saharan Africa after Nigeria and Algeria.
result: 二〇〇二年八月三十一日，安哥拉政府與全國解放聯盟代表在馬蘭熱省洛納簽訂《洛納備忘錄》，全國解放聯盟解散武裝，數千名戰鬥人員接受解除武裝與復員，戰爭至此結束，殘存的零星武裝衝突在往後數年內逐步收斂。這場戰爭的結果可以分三層看：軍事上，解放軍在南部高地的攻勢與一九八七年至一九八八年的奎托卡萬阿萊守城戰，把南非在安哥拉的前出基地推回邊界，一九九〇年納穆比亞獨立、全國解放聯盟失去後方之後，其野外軍最終在一九九九年至二〇〇〇年的攻勢中被逐出主要省份，薩文比陣亡與美國中止援助是直接原因；政治上，解放運動在一九九二年大選中未過半數仍保住國家權力，一九九三年第二輪的計票爭議引發戰事重開，最後以政府一方全面掌控的結局收場，全國解放聯盟由武裝組織轉為合法政黨；國際上，一九八八年《紐約協議》、一九九一年《比塞斯協議》與二〇〇二年《洛納備忘錄》構成了三段外交節點，最終以葡萄牙、聯合國與美國共同擔保的安排收束，南非在南部邊境的大規模駐軍於一九八九年結束，古巴軍隊於一九九一年七月前完全撤出，安哥拉從冷戰的最後一個大型前線變成普通的國家。此後二〇〇五年十一月大選解放運動取得國會過半席位，二〇二四年大選仍由解放運動領先，二〇一七年若昂·洛倫索接替多斯桑托斯成為總統，軍隊與政黨的格局再未改變。
resultEn: On 31 August 2002 the Angolan government and the representatives of UNITA signed the Luena Memorandum at Luena in Malanje province; UNITA dissolved its armed wing, several thousand fighters were disarmed and integrated, and the war came to an end, with the remaining sporadic clashes dying down over the following years. The outcome can be read at three levels. Militarily, the offensive in the southern highlands and the defence of Cuito Cuanavale in 1987 and 1988 pushed the South African forward bases back to the border; after Namibia became independent in 1990 and UNITA lost its rear, its field army was driven out of the main provinces by the offensives of 1999 and 2000, with Savimbi's death and the American cut-off of aid as the direct causes. Politically, the MPLA kept state power despite failing to win an outright majority in 1992; the dispute over the count in the 1993 second round restarted the war, and the fighting was closed with the government in full control, UNITA changing from an armed organisation into a legal party. Internationally, the New York Accords of 1988, the Bicesse Accords of 1991 and the Luena Memorandum of 2002 form three diplomatic milestones, and the war was finally wound up under an arrangement guaranteed by Portugal, the United Nations and the United States; South Africa's large presence on the southern border ended in 1989, the Cuban troops left completely by July 1991, and Angola went from being the last large front line of the Cold War to being an ordinary state. There followed the November 2005 election, in which the MPLA took an outright majority of seats in the assembly, the 2024 election, which the MPLA led again, and in 2017 João Lourenço succeeded dos Santos as president, after which the balance between the army and the party never changed again.
